WITH filtered_scans AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin,
    si.healtheval
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    healtheval,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0
      THEN CAST(gbsize AS REAL) / spanmin
    END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as scan_count
  FROM filtered_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_val
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  g.zoneref,
  g.healtheval,
  g.avg_ratio,
  g.scan_count,
  g.avg_ratio - o.mean_val as beat_amount
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
WHERE g.avg_ratio > o.mean_val
  AND o.mean_val IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY beat_amount DESC
LIMIT 10
